reads.sell: Barolo and Barbaresco are Nebbiolo at its noblest: pale in the glass but powerful, with sour cherry, roses, tar and dried herbs over firm tannin and bright acidity. Decant it and pour it with braised beef, a mushroom risotto or anything with truffle.

why.grape: A pale garnet colour hiding high tannin and high acidity, with the tar and roses nose, is Nebbiolo and nothing else.
why.climate: Tart to dried red fruit and high acidity, with alcohol that can still reach high, say a moderate continental climate with a long, late autumn.
